proof_summary: Using the carry identity for XOR, the target is converted to \(k+(k^2\mathbin{\mathrm{AND}}M)=N\), where \(M=2N+1\) and \(N\) is even; this congruence is solved bit by bit modulo \(2^w\), since adding \(2^i\) to \(k\) toggles exactly the next bit of the left side. Taking \(w=M+1\) leaves only the exact value or one overflow by \(2^w\); in the overflow case the reflected choice \(2^w-1-k\), together with complementary-square and AND/XOR identities, removes the overflow and yields an exact solution.
